claims.evidence: MaxQuant search txt.repopulated lists Emma_S1803_209..281 (+214, 285-287, S1804_005-008 which were not deposited) with Multiplicity 2, Labels1 Arg6;Lys8; 47 of them are deposited. txt.scaffold lists Emma_S1801_217..250 (Labels1 Lys6); the 12 deposited S1801 files are its Experiment 1 and match the decellularized-scaffold analysis (paper 2.2: 2 donors per group x triplicates; Supp. 2 heatmap columns HL 1:1..IPF 2:3). Those scaffolds contain no labelled material (H/L of summed intensity 0.15% in Experiment 1), and their raw sample IDs are SILAC_sample_1..12 with no donor key, so they are not SILAC-multiplexed samples and their identity is undocumented: left out (BLOCKED.md section PXD012322).

claims.value: SILAC light = pre-existing scaffold proteins; SILAC heavy = proteins newly synthesized by the seeded fibroblasts
claims.evidence: Paper 4.6: fibroblasts were pre-cultured 5 days in SILAC DMEM with heavy 13C6 L-arginine and 13C6 15N2 L-lysine and seeded on unlabelled decellularized scaffolds; 4.7: "scaffolds (decellularized or repopulated with heavy labeled cells)"; PRIDE description: heavy medium used "to differentiate between preexisting scaffold proteins and newly synthesized proteins". summary.txt: Multiplicity 2, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg6;Lys8 on every repopulated run. Data check: every run has heavy intensity (H share 2-21%), and the light channel carries the donor-specific scaffold signature (see disease claim).

Each raw file is one repopulated scaffold culture. Raw-header sample ID (FL9, FL10, FL11, Lures18, SAL23-SAL26) and vial position (A1..D12) are read from each .raw file; the channel suffix follows the label claim.

claims.location: characteristics[individual] light rows (odd rows 1,3,...,93); characteristics[scaffold individual] rows 1-94
claims.value: FL9, FL10, FL11, Lures18, SAL23, SAL24, SAL25, SAL26
claims.evidence: Sample ID field of each raw file header. Eight distinct codes, each on exactly 6 runs (FL11 on 5: Emma_S1803_214 = vial A5 was searched but not deposited), matching paper 2.3: scaffolds from four patients per group, duplicates, days 1/3/9 (4 x 2 x 3 = 24 per group). These codes are the deposit's own donor IDs; the paper's Table 1 uses HL 1-4 / IPF 1-4 and no source links the two.
Paper 4.6: "Human primary parenchymal lung fibroblasts were isolated from one healthy donor control lung"; the donor is not identified.

claims.location: characteristics[scaffold disease], factor value[scaffold disease], characteristics[disease] light rows (odd rows 1,3,...,93)
claims.value: idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (SAL23-SAL26), normal (FL9, FL10, FL11, Lures18)
claims.evidence: Paper 4.2: healthy donor lung explants came from Lund University hospital and IPF lung samples from Sahlgrenska University hospital (Gothenburg); the raw sample codes split 4 SAL (Sahlgrenska) / 4 FL+Lures (Lund) donors, matching n = 4 per group. Data check (datacheck.tsv): the paper reports laminin gamma2, beta3, alpha3 and collagen IV alpha3/alpha4 as significantly decreased in IPF scaffolds; in the light channel LAMB3/LAMC2/COL4A3/COL4A4 are ~0 in all 24 SAL runs and 1e8-5e9 in all 23 FL/Lures runs, with no overlap. Terms: idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis MONDO:0800504 (MONDO:0008345 is obsolete), normal PATO:0000461. Custom columns scaffold disease / scaffold individual (spec Extending Templates) carry the compared variable on both channels, because the heavy-channel material comes from healthy fibroblasts.
Paper 4.6: the fibroblasts were isolated from one healthy donor control lung. PATO:0000461.

claims.evidence: Light channel = decellularized lung tissue (scaffold); paper 4.1 decellularization and 2.1 "no signs of visible cells", so no cell type applies.
Scaffolds from peripheral lung parenchyma (paper 4.1); fibroblasts are lung parenchymal fibroblasts (4.6). UBERON:0002048.
PRIDE organism Homo sapiens; human donors; search against reviewed UniProt human (parameters.txt fasta swissprot_refproteome_human_20151117).

Table 1: all eight scaffold donors are aged 41-86 years (all >= 20Y, campaign rule 9), so every scaffold donor is adult regardless of the unknown code-to-ID link. EFO:0001272 adult. Heavy rows: fibroblast donor age not stated -> not available.

Table 1 gives age/sex per HL 1-4 / IPF 1-4, but no source maps those IDs to the deposited codes FL9..SAL26, so per-row values cannot be taken from an individual-level source (campaign rule 18). Fibroblast donor demographics are not stated. Ancestry not reported.

claims.value: normal: FL9=1, FL10=2, FL11=3, Lures18=4; IPF: SAL23=1, SAL24=2, SAL25=3, SAL26=4 (both channels of a run share the number)
claims.evidence: Paper 2.3 and Supplement 3/4 legends: "biological replicates per group n = 4, with technical replicates n = 2" - the biological replicate is the scaffold donor. Numbered 1..4 within each factor value group, one number per independent donor (README.adoc:330, campaign rule 3). Each culture has its own source name (vial in the name).

Cultures were harvested after 1, 3 and 9 days (paper 2.3/4.6). The runs fall into three blocks of 16 (vials A1-B4, B5-C8, C9-D12; MaxQuant experiments 1-16, 17-32, 33-48), each with every donor twice, so each block is probably one time point, but no source says which block is which day, and the heavy share does not rise monotonically across blocks (datacheck.tsv), so it cannot be inferred from the data either. Recorded in BLOCKED.md.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 12 decellularized-scaffold runs (Emma_S1801_217, 218, 219, 220, 222, 223, 224, 225, 227, 228, 229, 230) are not annotated: they contain no SILAC-labelled material (label-free in substance although searched as Multiplicity 2 / Lys6), and their raw sample IDs SILAC_sample_1..12 have no documented link to donors HL 1, HL 2, IPF 1, IPF 2 or replicates. BLOCKED.md section PXD012322.

characteristics[sampling time] = not available on every row: the day (1, 3 or 9) of each culture is not documented. The three vial blocks of 16 are probably the three time points, but the order is undocumented and the heavy share is not monotonic across blocks. Any time-course reuse needs the authors' sample sheet. BLOCKED.md section PXD012322.

Scaffold-donor age/sex are not available: Table 1 lists them for HL 1-4 / IPF 1-4, but nothing maps those IDs to the deposited codes FL9, FL10, FL11, Lures18, SAL23-SAL26. Lures18 is probably HL 4 (the only resection sample), but that is an inference and was not used.

Disease per scaffold donor rests on the paper's hospital-of-origin statement (IPF from Sahlgrenska, healthy from Lund) read against the SAL/FL code prefixes, cross-checked with the paper's IPF basement-membrane signature in the light channel (no overlap between groups). No source spells out the code-to-group key.

Light channel is not purely scaffold ECM: vimentin and other cellular proteins appear in the light channel (vimentin heavy share 3-73%), consistent with incomplete labelling after 5 days of pre-culture or residual cell remnants. The channel meaning follows the paper.
MaxQuant version: parameters.txt says 1.5.2.8 while the paper and PRIDE say 1.5.3.30.
Emma_S1803_214, 285, 286, 287 and Emma_S1804_005..008 were searched (txt.repopulated) but not deposited; 285-287/S1804 have no raw header to identify them.
Review not performed here (external hand-off; no self-review).
